# Maintainer documentation

This directory contains design notes, implementation status, audit evidence, and maintainer/agent procedures that are useful for project maintenance but are intentionally not part of the normal user-facing README documentation index.

The repository is public. This directory reduces presentation clutter; it is **not a confidentiality or access-control boundary**. Never commit credentials, private infrastructure details, personal data, or other secrets here.

## Contents

- `AGENT-IMPLEMENTATION-GUIDE.md` — detailed coding/operations agent maintenance rules.
- `DEVELOPMENT-DESIGN.md` — current implementation design and compatibility decisions.
- `IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md` — implementation/release evidence and remaining governance work.
- `CONSOLE-VERIFICATION.md` — Admin console reliability/design verification notes.
- `HARDENING-VERIFICATION.md` — historical v0.3.1 hardening evidence.

For the short repository-wide agent entrypoint, start with [`../../AGENTS.md`](../../AGENTS.md).
